{{*}} [[Garden of Tranquillity]] |quest2 = [[Swan Song]] |quest3 = [[Dragon Slayer II]] |quest4 = [[Making Friends with My Arm]] |location1 = [[Draynor Village]] |location2 = [[Draynor Village]] |location3 = [[Northern Ocean]] |location4 = N/A |shop1 = [[Quest point cape]] |shop2 = No |shop3 = No |shop4 = No |gender = Male |options = Talk-to |examine1 = A venerable and rich sage. |examine2 = A venerable sage. |examine3 = A venerable and rich sage. |examine4 = Maybe not all that wise yet, but pretty smart. |map1 = {{Map|name=Wise Old Man|x=3089|y=3254|mtype=pin}} |map2 = No |map3 = No |map4 = No |id1 = 2108,2112,2113,4306,4307,8052,8407,8409 |id2 = 2110,2111 |id3 = 8154,8162,8170 |id4 = 8410 |leagueRegion1 = Misthalin |leagueRegion2 = Misthalin |leagueRegion3 = Fremennik |leagueRegion4 = Fremennik }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Wise Old Man chathead.png|left]] |version2 = [[File:Wise Old Man (mortarboard) chathead.png|left]] |version3 = [[File:Wise Old Man chathead.png|left]] |version4 = [[File:Wise Young Man chathead.png|left]] }} '''Dionysius''', also known as the '''Wise Old Man''', is a legendary and very powerful [[Saradominist]] wizard and former adventurer, currently residing in [[Draynor Village]]. He is infamous for the [[Draynor bank robbery]]. He wears light brown robes, a regular [[blue cape]], [[partyhat & specs]], and wields a short [[staff]]. When asked, he tells the player about his feats throughout [[Gielinor]], and recognises players' own accomplishments – he sells the [[quest point cape]] and the [[quest point hood]] for 99,000 [[coins]] once all [[quest]]s have been completed, a total of {{Globals|quest points}} [[Quest points]]. He also offers a service to remove quest items or "junk" from the bank. Players can enter their bank pin to access the "[[Wise Old Man's Recycling Centre]]" showing unusable or otherwise worthless items, mostly from completed quests, which can all be removed from the bank at once. Lastly, if the player asks "Is there anything I can do for you?" he can assign [[Wise Old Man tasks|various tasks]] on [[members]]' worlds, in exchange for small rewards and experience. Being an iconic character, he has featured in various [[holiday events]], some as minor cameos, and others with more significant roles, like the [[2017 Christmas event]] in which he took over for [[Santa]] that year.
